# CANDIDATE: VIX_FLOOR_BEAR_ENTRY_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX floor of 20.0 to bearish entries will filter out low-VIX choppy environments that generate losers while preserving high-VIX fear-driven moves that produce winners. J's winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) exhibited elevated VIX, suggesting a regime filter can improve edge capture.

## Mechanism

In the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup, add a mandatory context filter: the VIX quote (as-of) must be >= 20.0 at the time of entry trigger. All other context filters (time, structure, ribbon, volume, news, loss budget, ribbon spread) and trigger logic (level rejection + EMA ribbon flip + confluence) remain unchanged. Exit logic (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1/scale-out, runner, time stop) is unaltered.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% of headline P&L (due to 50% per-trade risk cap and 3-contract minimum).
2. **Sample bias:** Will test on the full 16-month SPY 5m dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using the existing BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON signal as base. Sample size = number of trigger fires (to be measured). Overfit risk: adding a single threshold may curve-fit to noise; mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will perform walk-forward held-out window after Stage-1 backtest).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate top 3 J days via realistic OPRA simulation after Stage-1).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: filter removes a winner (e.g., if 4/29 VIX < 20) causing missed profit.
   - Max drawdown: could increase if filter avoids some winners while losers remain.
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent low-VIX regime (VIX < 20) where filter blocks all trades, yielding zero P&L and missed opportunity.
6. **Concentration:** To be measured post-Stage-1; if top-5 days represent >50% of P&L, will disclose.

## Pre-merge gate

Stage-1 backtest via autoresearch grinder harness must pass basic sanity (no crashes, produces equity curve). Followed by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on top 3 J days.
